title: Agricultural Land & Crop Production Management System
summary: Integrated web platform replacing fragmented spreadsheets with real-time plot mapping, crop cycle tracking, and automated harvest reporting.
problemMarkdown: A regional farming cooperative managing over 120 hectares across multiple districts struggled with disjointed Excel files for tracking fertilizer schedules, crop life-cycles, and harvest outputs. Data delays led to chemical misallocations and delayed delivery schedules.
solutionMarkdown: Designed and deployed a responsive management portal allowing field supervisors to log plot conditions, soil metrics, and treatments via mobile-friendly forms, while management receives real-time production analytics and automated weekly export summaries.
roleMarkdown: Lead Full-Stack Architect: Conducted operational discovery with cooperative managers, designed relational schema, implemented the backend API, and built automated reporting pipelines.
implementationMarkdown: Constructed a modular micro-service with FastAPI and Next.js, orchestrated with Docker Compose on self-hosted infrastructure. Integrated automated n8n workflows for daily data verification and scheduled Telegram alert digests for plot anomalies.
resultsMarkdown: Eliminated 100% of spreadsheet version conflicts, reduced weekly reporting turnaround from 14 hours to under 15 minutes, and saved an estimated 12% in seasonal fertilizer wastage.

cover.alt: Dashboard view of Agricultural Land Management system displaying plot metrics

title: Automated HR Employment Document Processing Pipeline
summary: AI-assisted intake pipeline that extracts, validates, and archives candidate employment records and contracts with 98% accuracy.
problemMarkdown: An HR department onboarding 200+ seasonal employees monthly spent over 40 hours per week manually transcribing citizen IDs, health certificates, and contracts into HRMS spreadsheets, suffering from frequent typographical errors.
solutionMarkdown: Engineered an intelligent document intake pipeline with automated OCR preprocessing, LLM schema extraction, and human-in-the-loop review for low-confidence fields.
roleMarkdown: AI Automation Engineer: Implemented OCR image rectification, custom extraction prompts, webhook connectors, and validation rules.
implementationMarkdown: Built an n8n processing pipeline that watches secure cloud intake folders, triggers OCR inference on GPU-enabled workers, normalizes Vietnamese accents and national ID numbers, and flags ambiguous records for human verification.
resultsMarkdown: Reduced candidate intake processing time from 25 minutes per applicant to 45 seconds, with an overall extraction accuracy exceeding 98.4% across 1,500+ processed documents.

cover.alt: OCR pipeline dashboard showing document verification stages

title: PAB University Academic Portal & Grade Audit Automation
summary: Headless browser automation and verification engine synchronizing academic transcripts and cross-faculty grade submissions.
problemMarkdown: Academic advisors faced severe bottlenecks during end-of-semester grade reconciliation due to legacy student portal limitations and manual copy-pasting of multi-department course records.
solutionMarkdown: Developed an audited, idempotent RPA automation script running in isolated headless containers that extracts transcripts, reconciles discrepancies against faculty submission sheets, and generates audit reports.
roleMarkdown: Automation Architect: Created resilient headless browser scripts with session handling, error backoff, and cryptographic audit trails.
implementationMarkdown: Combined Playwright browser automation with n8n workflow triggers. Built reconciliation algorithms that detect grading anomalies and mismatching credit counts before committing final data.
resultsMarkdown: Processed 4,200 student grade files in under 2 hours without a single transcription error, cutting faculty overtime by 90% during grading periods.

title: Zalo Medical Consultation & Appointment Booking Bot
summary: 24/7 intelligent patient assistance bot on Zalo OA triaging clinic inquiries, scheduling doctor appointments, and sending appointment reminders.
problemMarkdown: A dental and cosmetic clinic experienced high abandonment rates on customer inquiries outside clinic working hours (6 PM - 8 AM), resulting in lost consultations and high front-desk phone congestion during peak mornings.
solutionMarkdown: Built an intelligent Zalo Official Account chatbot with natural language understanding to answer common treatment FAQs, verify doctor availability in real-time, and confirm bookings directly into clinic schedules.
roleMarkdown: Conversational AI Developer: Configured Zalo OA webhooks, authored prompt safety guardrails, built intent classification nodes, and integrated booking calendar APIs.
implementationMarkdown: Designed an n8n webhook listener that processes incoming Zalo messages, uses an LLM with strict clinic knowledge grounding for FAQs, and transitions seamlessly to structured booking workflows.
resultsMarkdown: Handled 1,800+ patient inquiries in the first 60 days with 0 medical hallucinations, increasing off-hour booking conversions by 42% and eliminating receptionist phone queueing.

cover.alt: Zalo medical consultation bot workflow overview

title: Autonomous Multilingual Research & News Digest Agent
summary: Autonomous AI agent that crawls, synthesizes, and generates audio podcast digests from global technology publications every morning.
problemMarkdown: Information overload across academic preprint servers and international technology news made it impossible for busy developers and researchers to stay up to date with relevant breakthroughs.
solutionMarkdown: Created an end-to-end pipeline that crawls selected RSS and research portals, evaluates paper significance, writes concise bullet summaries in Vietnamese and English, and produces synthetic speech audio digests.
roleMarkdown: Solo Developer & Creator: Designed agentic crawler with LangGraph, implemented content scoring heuristics, and deployed automated morning audio delivery.
implementationMarkdown: The workflow runs every morning at 6:00 AM via scheduled cron, deduplicates articles via vector embeddings, filters key insights using Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and renders clean audio files via local TTS.
resultsMarkdown: Delivered 120+ consecutive daily audio editions without failure, condensing 3 hours of daily reading into an actionable 10-minute briefing.

title: Vocational Center Omnichannel Lead Routing & Consultation Workflow
summary: Unified lead capture workflow connecting Facebook Ads, website landing pages, and Zalo OA directly to admissions counselors.
problemMarkdown: A specialized training academy lost up to 30% of advertising leads due to response latency averaging 4 hours across siloed communication channels.
solutionMarkdown: Engineered a unified n8n automation pipeline that captures leads instantaneously from web forms, Facebook webhook events, and Zalo inquiries, deduplicating them and alerting the on-duty counselor on Telegram within 10 seconds.
roleMarkdown: Systems Integration Engineer: Unified disparate webhook formats, designed round-robin counselor assignment, and built instant notification dispatchers.
implementationMarkdown: Consolidated webhook payloads, validated phone numbers with Vietnamese regex patterns, synced rows to Google Sheets, and dispatched interactive Telegram notifications with one-click call buttons.
resultsMarkdown: Reduced average first-response time from 4.2 hours to under 3 minutes, boosting enrollment consultation conversion by 28%.

title: B2B Medical Device Distribution Lead Qualification Engine
summary: Intelligent qualification agent assessing clinic purchasing criteria, license verification, and equipment requirements for sales reps.
problemMarkdown: Medical equipment distributors received high volumes of non-qualified quote requests, distracting technical sales specialists with inquiries from unregistered practices or students seeking project quotes.
solutionMarkdown: Implemented an AI qualification system that ingests inquiry emails and RFQ forms, checks business registration databases, classifies purchasing urgency and facility capabilities, and generates a pre-qualification briefing sheet for account managers.
roleMarkdown: AI Solutions Developer: Designed qualification scoring rubric, built data enrichment scripts, and integrated CRM pipeline stages.
implementationMarkdown: Developed an n8n workflow orchestrated with a dedicated FastAPI microservice that extracts clinical requirements, parses attached PDF specifications, and computes a qualification score from 0 to 100.
resultsMarkdown: Filtered out 65% of unqualified inquiries before sales specialist review, increasing qualified opportunity win rates by 22%.

title: Low-Latency Vietnamese Speech Recognition & Synthesis Pipeline
summary: Self-hosted speech inference cluster optimized for real-time Vietnamese transcription and expressive neural voice generation.
problemMarkdown: Commercial speech APIs imposed high recurring token costs and unacceptable round-trip latency (>1,200ms) for voice interaction prototypes, making real-time voice conversations clunky.
solutionMarkdown: Built an optimized on-premise inference pipeline utilizing Faster-Whisper with INT8 quantization for ASR and lightweight VITS models for Vietnamese speech synthesis, achieving sub-350ms streaming latency.
roleMarkdown: Machine Learning Engineer: Benchmarked model architectures, converted weights to ONNX/TensorRT, and built streaming WebSocket server.
implementationMarkdown: Engineered asynchronous FastAPI WebSocket endpoints managing streaming audio buffers, Voice Activity Detection (VAD), and token-by-token synthesis piping.
resultsMarkdown: Achieved sub-350ms end-to-end voice latency on a single consumer GPU while saving $400/month in cloud transcription costs.

cover.alt: Real-time speech inference pipeline audio waveform visualizer

title: Interactive STEM Physics Simulation & Virtual Laboratory
summary: Web-based interactive physics experiments allowing high school students to visualize mechanics, electromagnetic fields, and wave phenomena.
problemMarkdown: Schools lacking equipped laboratory hardware struggle to provide students with tangible, hands-on physics experimentation, resulting in lower conceptual comprehension and test performance.
solutionMarkdown: Created an interactive browser simulation platform where students manipulate physical constants (gravity, friction, magnetic flux) in real time with continuous parameter graphs and dynamic hints.
roleMarkdown: Full-Stack Developer: Modeled numerical physics engines in TypeScript, built responsive Canvas visualizations, and implemented student exercise progress tracking.
implementationMarkdown: Utilized Verlet numerical integration for stable multi-body physics calculations, coupled with high-performance 2D Canvas rendering that runs at a consistent 60fps even on low-powered mobile devices.
resultsMarkdown: Adopted by over 500 students in pilot testing with an 88% positive engagement rating and noticeable improvements in kinematics quiz scores.

title: Autonomous RC Vehicle with Edge Computer Vision & Telemetry
summary: Edge-computed autonomous 1/10th scale rover equipped with lane-following vision, obstacle avoidance, and real-time WebRTC video streaming.
problemMarkdown: Developing robust edge robotics algorithms on resource-constrained micro-computers requires tight synchronization between high-speed camera sensors, motor microcontrollers, and wireless control protocols.
solutionMarkdown: Built a modular autonomous rover platform featuring Raspberry Pi edge inference, lightweight CNN models for lane tracking, ultrasonic depth arrays for failsafe stopping, and low-latency WebRTC teleoperation.
roleMarkdown: Robotics & Embedded AI Engineer: Built hardware wiring harness, trained perception neural network, and wrote real-time telemetry dashboard.
implementationMarkdown: Trained a quantized MobileNet backbone to predict steering angles directly from monocular video frames, communicating with motor controllers via PWM over I2C at 50Hz update rates.
resultsMarkdown: Achieved continuous autonomous track navigation at speeds up to 18 km/h with sub-80ms control loop latency.
